verdict.rationale: Slack's Web API is documented as using scoped bot/user tokens (slack-probe-5, slack-supp-openapi-spec) and admins can approve/manage MCP client integrations for governance (slack-docs-46), which supports issuing least-privilege credentials for agent integrations. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of a scope-selection workflow, per-agent token issuance UI, or examples of restricting an agent's OAuth scopes specifically. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on creating/limiting OAuth scopes per agent, a scope-selection reference for MCP/agent use cases, and independent confirmation that least-privilege scoping works as intended in agent contexts.
